name: Calypso
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taker with four decks where each player has a personal trump suit and aims to build full suit sequences.
rules_text: Calypso is for 4 players in two fixed partnerships, partners opposite. Four 52-card decks are shuffled together into a 208-card stock. The game has four deals. Each deal 52 cards are dealt, 13 to each player, leaving the rest for later deals. Each player is assigned a different personal trump suit for the whole game. Trick-taking is clockwise: must follow the led suit if able, else may play any card. If any trump is played, the highest trump that is a personal trump of its owner wins; otherwise highest card of led suit wins. Winner keeps the trick and leads. After the deal, players pool tricks by partnership and extract cards of their two trump suits to form 13-card A-to-2 sequences (calypsos). Each completed calypso scores heavily, incomplete sets score less. After four deals highest partnership total wins.
rating_reason: Four-player partnership trick-taking game, specific rules, strategic bidding
